messages:
Ravi: quick sync  i'm iterating on the API Keys list + detail screen, want feedback on revoke placement and empty-state guidance. pic in figma.

Emma: saw it. small thing: the kebab revoke is easy to miss for new users. recommend a clear "Danger" area on detail view with a red outline and a primary revoke button.

Luis (PM): agree. also some customers asked for quick templates on the empty state so they don't have to guess scopes. can we add 2 micro-templates: \u2014 "Client (read-only)" and "Server (full)" with one-line descriptions and a quick "Create from template" link.

Ada (Design): templates are fine but keep the empty canvas light. Main CTA remains "Create key"; show templates as secondary cards under a small heading "Try a template".

Ravi: good, i'll mock as compact chips under the CTA. another UX question: when rotating, we show the new secret and a warning below. currently the warning text is long. we should show a short sentence + an expand for details.

Emma: short sentence yes. propose: "A new key will be issued. Update clients to use the new value." link to "See rollout tips".

Ada (Design): rollout tips can be a panel with 3 bullets: overlap option, propagation checklist, how to revoke old key safely. keep bullets one line each.

Luis (PM): language: avoid technical words like "propagation" for general users. use "time to take effect" or "time to update clients".

a11y-bot: reminder: modal headings should be programmatically focused and the first focusable element should be the close button or the first control depending on primary path. Use aria-describedby for the warning paragraph.

Ravi: noted. about overlap: product asked to default overlap off. if enabled show countdown on details and a calendar-like expiry time. the countdown should not be the only indicator (also show absolute end time).

Emma: agreed. and when overlap is enabled, show a small banner on the org's keys page: "Overlap active on X key 0m left" with a link to key details.

Ada (Design): one accessibility nit: make sure the countdown isn't the only indicator color-wise. include an icon and text.

Luis (PM): revoke copy: current modal says "Revoke this key?" can we sharpen: "Permanently stop this key" and subcopy: "All services using this key will lose access immediately." two short sentences.

Ravi: we'll change copy. also adding a required checkbox "I understand this will immediately stop traffic" before enabling revoke CTA.

a11y-bot: checkbox must be keyboard accessible, label visible, and error state announced. When revoke succeeds show a toast with role=alert.

Emma: on create flow: add name helper text: "e.g., payments-service-prod" and a character limit with visual counter. if a name is duplicated show inline validation with suggested suffixes.

Ada (Design): UI microcopy: keep examples lowercase and hyphenated  consistent with other product areas.

Ravi: action items: i'll update figma with templates under empty state, move revoke into danger zone, shorten rotate copy with "see tips" expand, add overlap UI and countdown + absolute end time.

Luis (PM): i'll draft the final copy variants and share here for review. thanks all.

a11y-bot: deploy note: staging build with keys CSS landed 2026-03-24T17:00Z per infra. test focus states after deploy.

Ravi: thanks 44d i'll ping when mocks are updated and tag for a11y review.
